name: Connectivity-based Visibility for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A visibility solution that uses a connectivity relationship graph to retrieve only visible points from a point cloud for blending, replacing the standard depth-ordered blending of all overlapping points in 3DGS.
summary: Connectivity-based Visibility for 3D Gaussian Splatting replaces standard depth-ordered blending with a connectivity graph to filter only visible points, reducing memory and accelerating rendering for large-scale scenes.
